description: Clover 2 is Kitani's 27.8B dense model: a BF16 base with seven LoRA experts and trained per-token routing between them. This variant thinks before answering; tool calling is not available. Its 32,768-token context window is shared by input and output, with up to 8,192 output tokens. Free during its first week, until November 24, 2026 03:33 UTC.
name: Clover 2 Thinking
